question: In a circle with center O, an arc ABC subtends an angle of 138º at the center of the circle. The chord AB is produced to a point P. Then, the measure of ∠CBP is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The angle subtended by an arc at the circumference is half the angle subtended at the center.

⇒ Interior opposite angle = 138º ÷ 2 = 69º.

For any cyclic quadrilateral, the exterior angle is directly equal to the interior opposite angle.

⇒ ∠CBP = 69º.

**∴ The correct answer is 69º.**
